intro.features_description: StingStream works with a few optional services. You will find them in Settings:
intro.jellyseerr_feature_description: Connect to your Seerr instance and request movies directly in the app.
intro.downloads_feature_description: Download movies and series to watch offline.
intro.chromecast_feature_description: Cast movies and series to your Chromecast devices.
intro.centralised_settings_plugin_description: Settings can be managed centrally on your server. Every device syncs automatically.
intro.crash_reports_description: StingStream sends anonymous crash and error reports to the developers when this is turned on. No account data or server addresses are included. You can turn this off here or anytime in settings.

sharing.mesh_unavailable_title: Sharing is not running on this server
sharing.mesh_unavailable_detail: Groups and members are unavailable until it comes back. Playback still works — your server proxies the stream instead.
sharing.empty_title: Share your library with people you trust.
sharing.empty_detail: A group pools everyone's library. Nothing leaves it, there is no public directory, and the only way in is an invite code.
sharing.admin_only_reason: Creating and joining groups are administrator actions on your server.
sharing.sync_error_title: This device could not join every group
sharing.sync_error_detail: Playback still works — the server proxies the stream instead.
sharing.leave_confirm_warning: This device stops gossiping, drops the shared index and forgets the group secret. Titles held by other members disappear from your library. Rejoining needs a new invite code.
sharing.members_hint: "Direct" means bytes travel peer to peer; "relayed" means they pass through a relay, which still works but costs someone bandwidth. A member with no path yet is simply one nothing has been asked of.
sharing.members_empty_hint: Share an invite code to add one.
sharing.members_unavailable: This server could not be asked who is in the group: {{message}}
sharing.remove_member_warning: {{name}} loses access to {{group}} immediately, and the group's secret is rotated so it cannot get back in. Every invite code handed out before now stops working, including any this screen has already shown. There is no undo: the only way back is a fresh invite.
sharing.removing_member: Removing {{name}} and rotating the secret. The new secret is handed to every member that is awake, one at a time, so this can take a few minutes. Leave this screen open.
sharing.member_removed_result_one: {{name}} removed. {{count}} member took the new secret; the rest take it the next time they connect.
sharing.member_removed_result_other: {{name}} removed. {{count}} members took the new secret; the rest take it the next time they connect.
sharing.member_removed_result: {{name}} removed. {{count}} members took the new secret; the rest take it the next time they connect.
sharing.rotate_secret_warning: Every invite code handed out before now stops working, including any this screen has already shown. Nobody is removed: every current member is handed the new secret, and the ones that are asleep take it the next time they connect.
sharing.rotating_secret: Rotating the secret. The new secret is handed to every member that is awake, one at a time, so this can take a few minutes. Leave this screen open.
sharing.rotate_secret_result_one: Secret rotated. {{count}} member took the new one; the rest take it the next time they connect.
sharing.rotate_secret_result_other: Secret rotated. {{count}} members took the new one; the rest take it the next time they connect.
sharing.rotate_secret_result: Secret rotated. {{count}} members took the new one; the rest take it the next time they connect.
sharing.secret_never_rotated: The secret has never been rotated · epoch {{epoch}}
sharing.rendezvous_description: A rendezvous server is optional. Without one a group uses public infrastructure — iroh's relays, n0 DNS and the BitTorrent DHT — plus StingStream's shared fallback. A rendezvous server adds rendezvous when the inviter is offline, a relay on TCP 443 and the HTTPS side door. It is a property of the group: it travels in every invite code, and changing it later reaches every member.
sharing.rendezvous_custom_subtitle: A rendezvous server you or a friend hosts
sharing.rendezvous_check_hint: Enter the hostname of a running rendezvous server. It is checked against its own /healthz before it can be stored on the group.
sharing.rendezvous_host_your_own_subtitle: One-click Railway template, or a VPS compose file
sharing.rendezvous_change_note: The change is gossiped to the whole group, signed by this server. Members that are offline adopt it when they return, and invite codes minted afterwards carry it — codes already handed out still work.
sharing.rendezvous_change_success: Rendezvous server set to {{host}}. Every member follows.
sharing.rendezvous_change_success_default: Back to public infrastructure. Every member follows.
sharing.invite_description: This code carries the group secret. Anyone who has it can join and see everything the group holds, so send it the way you would send a password.
sharing.invite_copy_failed: Could not copy — select the code and copy it by hand.
sharing.invite_clipboard_unavailable: Clipboard is not available in this build.
sharing.invite_note_online: Joining needs a member online, so keep this server running until they are in — unless the group has a rendezvous server, which remembers member addresses for exactly this case.
sharing.invite_note_revocation: Codes stop working once a member is removed — a fresh invite is needed after that.
sharing.create_detail: A group is a set of servers that pool their libraries. Nothing leaves a group, there is no public directory, and the only way in is an invite code.
sharing.create_live_detail: Your server is its first member. Send this code to whoever should join.
sharing.join_detail: Paste the invite code a member sent you. It carries the group's address and secret, so treat it like a password — and it only works while a member is online, unless the group has a rendezvous server.
sharing.join_success_no_answer: Joined {{name}}, but nobody answered. It will sync when a member comes online.
sharing.join_clipboard_denied: The browser would not share the clipboard.
sharing.join_tv_hint: There is no camera here, so the code has to be pasted or typed. Invite codes use base58, which has no look-alike characters — no 0/O and no 1/l/I — and carries a checksum, so a mistyped code is refused rather than half-joining.
sharing.join_camera_detail: Scanning an invite needs the camera. You can always type the code instead.
sharing.join_camera_hint: Point the camera at the invite QR on the other device.
sharing.this_device_unavailable_web: Streams go through your server on the web.
sharing.this_device_unavailable_native: This build doesn't include peer-to-peer sharing, so streams go through your server.

requests.discover_prompt_detail: Search for a film or series. Results say whether somebody in your group already has it, so you never ask for a download that would not happen.
requests.discover_empty_detail: Neither the movie manager nor the series manager found anything for "{{term}}". Both have to be configured on this server for search to work.

requests.delete_confirm_detail: This takes it off your list. It does not stop a download already in progress — the fulfilling node may be somebody else's and is already committed.
requests.approvals_empty_detail: Requests the group policy auto-approves never appear here. Change who needs approving under Policy.
requests.alerts_empty_detail: You will be told here when a request is approved, declined, or lands in your library.
requests.alerts_kept_note: The newest 200 are kept. The request itself is the durable record.
requests.policy_mode_everyone_detail: Every member's requests start straight away. Best in a household where everybody already shares the bandwidth.
requests.policy_mode_trusted_detail: Administrators and the members you have marked trusted below skip the queue; everybody else waits.
requests.policy_mode_admins_only_detail: Only an administrator's own requests skip the queue. Every other request waits for a decision.
requests.policy_quota_detail: 0 means no limit. Declined requests do not count.
requests.policy_trust_hint: Trusted members skip the queue under the Trusted policy. It has no effect under the other two.

server_settings.external_clients_empty_detail: StingStream downloads through its own two engines. Add one here if you already run a client somewhere else.
server_settings.external_clients_explainer: A client running somewhere else — a seedbox, an existing qBittorrent or SABnzbd. It is registered in both the movie manager and the series manager alongside the engines above, at a lower priority, so StingStream's own engines stay the default.
server_settings.external_clients_password_placeholder: Password, or an API key for SABnzbd
server_settings.external_clients_remove_confirm_message: It is removed from StingStream's settings and from the movie manager and the series manager. Downloads already running in it are not touched.
server_settings.indexers_empty_detail: Add a Torznab indexer above — it is pushed into both the movie manager and the series manager.
server_settings.indexers_name_and_url_required: Name and Torznab base URL are required
server_settings.indexers_remove_confirm_message: "{{name}}" is removed from StingStream's settings. It stays configured inside the movie manager and the series manager until it is removed there too — sync only ever adds and updates.
server_settings.indexers_test_error: Neither app could be asked about it.
server_settings.indexers_test_explainer: "Test" asks the movie manager and the series manager to try it, using exactly the resource a save would store. The two send different category lists, so both are asked: an endpoint with films but no television passes one and fails the other.
server_settings.notifications_webhook_group_title: StingStream's own webhook (drives the federated import path)
server_settings.quality_profiles_default_name_detail: Used when adding a title without picking one. Empty means "whatever the app lists first".
server_settings.quality_profiles_delete_confirm_message: The profile is removed from both the movie manager and the series manager. An app will refuse if any title is still using it.
server_settings.quality_profiles_empty_detail: Neither app has one, which normally means neither has finished starting. Press "New" to create one in both.
server_settings.quality_profiles_no_vocabulary: Neither app answered with a quality list.
server_settings.quality_profiles_pick_qualities_first: Pick some qualities first — the cutoff has to be one of them.
server_settings.quality_profiles_rename_hint: The name is the profile's identity in both apps, so it cannot be renamed here — a rename that succeeded in one app and failed in the other would leave two half-profiles. Create the new one and delete this.
server_settings.quality_profiles_showing_every_detail: Every quality either app knows. One app will ignore what it does not have, and say so when you save.
server_settings.quality_profiles_showing_shared_detail: The qualities the movie manager and the series manager both understand — the safe set for a profile that governs films and series alike.
server_settings.quality_profiles_upgrade_title: Upgrade an existing file when a better release appears
server_settings.sync_all_synced: The movie manager and the series manager are in sync.
server_settings.torrent_dht_detail: Off by default. A trackerless magnet is refused up front rather than stalling while off.
server_settings.torrent_listen_port_detail: 0 asks the OS for an ephemeral port

server_status.mesh_unavailable_detail: This server hasn't joined a group yet, or hasn't found any other members.
server_status.side_door_no_coordinator_detail: No rendezvous server is set, so a remote address can't be issued yet.
server_status.side_door_plain_fallback: Falling back to a plain address on your own network: {{url}}
server_status.side_door_rebinding_detail: Your router won't answer this address's local hostname, so connections that could stay on your network are leaving it instead. Check your router's DNS rebinding protection settings.
server_status.side_door_rebinding_title: Your router may be blocking local addresses
server_status.side_door_zone_pending_detail: A zone is set but no address has been issued yet.
server_status.version_unknown_hint: A dash means that component hasn't reported a version yet.
